characters.name: Director
characters.voice_notes: Warm, wise school director. Calm, measured, friendly.

turns.line: Good morning, Lily. Welcome to International School Bangkok. Please, come in.
Thank you. It's great to be here.
We like to start with a handshake. (chuckling) A good first impression matters.
I agree. I make eye contact and smile when I meet someone new.
Tell me about yourself. What are your best skills?
My best skill is communication. I listen well, and I enjoy talking to new people.
That's important. What about teamwork?
I'm a real team player. I like helping my group stay calm and focused.
Are you a natural leader?
Sometimes. I stay calm under pressure, so people trust me with decisions.
Have you ever had to be decisive in a difficult moment?
Yes. Last year, our school play lost its director. I came up with a new plan, and we acted out all the scenes in one week.
Wonderful. Did you ever want to give up?
No. Some friends dropped out of the play, but I faced up to the challenge. Hard work pays off.
What do you want to work on?
My time management. I sometimes leave big tasks to the last minute.
Patience helps. Good time management is a skill you can learn.
Thank you. I really hope I get a place at your school.
You made a lasting impression today, Lily. We'll be in touch soon.
Thank you. I look forward to hearing from you.
